stances_toward.note: Partner: party-to-party cooperation without alignment. To Lam made a state visit to Pyongyang on 9-11 Oct 2025, the first Vietnamese leader-level trip since 2007 and only the second since 1950, timed to the party's 80th anniversary, and agreed to deepen exchanges and coordinate at the UN and the ASEAN Regional Forum. Hanoi is balancing (Stratfor): it keeps its ties with Seoul and Washington. Treasury's 12 Mar 2026 designations include a Vietnam-based facilitator of IT-worker payments. Hanoi hosted the failed 2019 Trump-Kim summit. Bond - affinity: communist single-party states.
